# `vault plugin reload-status`

Check the status of an active or recently completed global plugin reload.

<EnterpriseAlert inline="true" />

<CodeBlockConfig hideClipboard>

```shell-session
$ vault plugin reload-status RELOAD_ID [options]
$ vault plugin reload-status [-help | -h]
```

</CodeBlockConfig>

## Description

The [`vault plugin reload`](/vault/docs/commands/plugin/reload) command returns a
reload ID when you start a global plugin reload. Use that ID with
`vault plugin reload-status` to view the result reported by each participating
Vault node.

The status command displays a row for each result. A `Success` value of `true`
means the node completed the reload without an error. The `Message` column
contains an error message when the reload fails on a node.

Vault removes reload status records after their retention period. Check the
status before the records expire.

## Command arguments

- `RELOAD_ID` `(string: required)` - The ID returned by a global
  `vault plugin reload` command.

## Command options

None.

## Command flags

None.

## Examples

Start a global reload and save the reload ID from the output:

```shell-session
$ vault plugin reload \
    -type=database \
    -plugin=vault-plugin-database-oracle \
    -scope=global
Success! Reloading plugin: vault-plugin-database-oracle, reload_id: 8fae49fd-e8d9-4bf8-9567-1cb7cb2437a9
```

Use the reload ID to check node results:

```shell-session
$ vault plugin reload-status 8fae49fd-e8d9-4bf8-9567-1cb7cb2437a9
Time     | Participant        | Success | Message
10:15:30 | participant-uuid-1 | true    |
10:15:31 | participant-uuid-2 | true    |
```

For the HTTP API equivalent, refer to
[`GET /sys/plugins/reload/backend/status`](/vault/api-docs/system/plugins-reload#get-global-plugin-reload-status).
